metadata.faiss_scope_notice: FAISS is an in-process vector similarity-search C++ library and algorithmic compute baseline, not a full client-server vector database. It lacks a network daemon, durability (WAL), CRUD mutations, metadata payload filtering, and distributed clustering.
metadata.workload_scope_notice: The empirical benchmark results apply strictly to this controlled workload (1,000 documents, 50 queries, 384 dimensions, local execution) and should not be treated as universal performance claims.

technical_matrix_rows.Qdrant: Rust-powered speed, single-stage payload graph traversal, flexible embedded and cluster modes.
technical_matrix_rows.Chroma: Zero-friction Python developer experience; ideal for rapid prototyping and local LLM agents.
technical_matrix_rows.FAISS: Gold standard algorithmic search performance; ultra-low in-memory latency with zero daemon overhead.
technical_matrix_rows.Milvus: Massive horizontal scalability to billions of vectors with decoupled cloud-native storage nodes.
technical_matrix_rows.Weaviate: First-class GraphQL/gRPC developer APIs with native hybrid BM25 search and modular ML vectorizers.
technical_matrix_rows.pgvector: Full relational ACID compliance; joins vector similarity directly with existing transactional tables.
technical_matrix_rows.Elasticsearch: Unrivaled enterprise text search, logging, and inverted-index BM25 combined with Lucene HNSW vectors.
technical_matrix_rows.Pinecone: Zero infrastructure administration; fully managed cloud autoscaling with pay-as-you-go pricing.

technical_matrix_rows.Qdrant: High memory consumption for uncompressed HNSW graphs; smaller ecosystem than Elasticsearch.
technical_matrix_rows.Chroma: Single-writer SQLite bottleneck in embedded mode; lacks advanced multi-tenant cluster features.
technical_matrix_rows.FAISS: Not a database: in-process similarity search library only; lacks network server daemon, client-server API protocols, storage durability (WAL), CRUD mutations, security, multi-tenancy, and metadata payload filtering.
technical_matrix_rows.Milvus: High deployment complexity (requires Etcd, MinIO, Pulsar microservices); steep operational overhead.
technical_matrix_rows.Weaviate: Heavy memory footprint for HNSW graphs; complex configuration for enterprise multi-tenancy.
technical_matrix_rows.pgvector: Lower QPS and higher latency under heavy vector search compared to specialized Rust/C++ native engines.
technical_matrix_rows.Elasticsearch: Substantial JVM memory heap requirements; slower vector ingestion throughput than native vector DBs.
technical_matrix_rows.Pinecone: Proprietary cloud lock-in; ongoing SaaS subscription costs; network WAN round-trip latency.

technical_matrix_rows.Qdrant: High-throughput RAG systems requiring rich metadata payload filtering and sub-10ms response times.
technical_matrix_rows.Chroma: Local desktop AI apps, Jupyter notebook experiments, rapid PoCs, and embedded RAG prototypes.
technical_matrix_rows.FAISS: Algorithmic research, offline batch vector clustering, GPU vector search, and custom inference backends.
technical_matrix_rows.Milvus: Large-scale enterprise vector platforms exceeding 100M+ vectors with distributed data pipelines.
technical_matrix_rows.Weaviate: Complex multimodal search and hybrid RAG pipelines leveraging native BM25 + dense retrieval.
technical_matrix_rows.pgvector: Existing PostgreSQL applications needing semantic search without introducing a second database stack.
technical_matrix_rows.Elasticsearch: Enterprise search platforms where dense vector similarity is added alongside massive text catalogs.
technical_matrix_rows.Pinecone: Fast-moving AI startups wanting serverless vector infrastructure without dedicated DevOps engineers.
